newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.04 up at 40.08 to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday amid high supplies of the U.S. currency, but is likely open lower on Tuesday, dealers said.
"The current levels are very attractive for buying the dollar," one dealer said, adding that more players were likely to move into dollars despite high supplies from abroad.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 8.20 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
